rubrics.justification: Accurately identifies a full blastocyst with blastocoel filling most of the embryo and gives a reasonable ICM/TE assessment consistent with 2AA; minor limitation is lack of deeper comment on somewhat indistinct ICM/TE boundaries and zona features.
Thoroughly integrates age, diminished ovarian reserve/low oocyte yield, prior failed cycle, BMI, sperm parameters, and endometrial thickness with embryo quality and prognosis.

Reasoning is logical and internally consistent, with prognosis tied to embryo quality and patient factors; slight overemphasis on ovarian reserve as affecting implantation of the current embryo rather than mainly cumulative future success.

Generally consistent with Gardner grading interpretation, single embryo transfer principles, and cautious use of PGT-A in low embryo-yield patients; a few future protocol suggestions are broader and less directly guideline-driven.

Provides practical next steps for current transfer and future cycles, including luteal support adherence, review of prior cycle details, protocol discussion, weight optimization, and uterine cavity evaluation if failures continue.
